g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: D1 (series Schottky) is required: the EEPROM is wired to SDA/SCL, and the badge's I2C pull-ups must not push current into the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: D1 (series Schottky) is required: the EEPROM is wired to SDA/SCL, and the badge's I2C pull-ups must not push current into the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.text: Fit R1-R3 to move the address (0x50 + A2*4 + A1*2 + A0); fit R4 to write-protect the whole chip.

g.desc: Fit R1-R3 to move the address (0x50 + A2*4 + A1*2 + A0); fit R4 to write-protect the whole chip.

g.text: R1-R3 (A0-A2) and R4 (WP) are the maker's optional straps, NOT FITTED: the chip pulls those pins low itself, so the EEPROM answers at 0x50 and can be written.

g.desc: R1-R3 (A0-A2) and R4 (WP) are the maker's optional straps, NOT FITTED: the chip pulls those pins low itself, so the EEPROM answers at 0x50 and can be written.

g.text: Maker's circuit kept: CAT24C256 on SDA/SCL, C1 = supply decoupling. No pull-ups on SDA/SCL (the badge provides them).

g.desc: Maker's circuit kept: CAT24C256 on SDA/SCL, C1 = supply decoupling. No pull-ups on SDA/SCL (the badge provides them).

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the EEPROM. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the EEPROM. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
